method: Owner-authorized USB programming and serial-protocol integration: esptool flash_id; complete read_flash 0 0x1000000 backup; PlatformIO nobuild/upload application plus esptool write_flash bootloader and partition table; esptool verify_flash all three images; UART115200 boot capture and stop command.
environment: Physical ESP32-S3 revision0.2, 16MiB quad flash3.3V and 8MiB PSRAM; COM7 CH343 USB-UART. Servo supply OFF explicitly reported by owner. Windows OpenAI Codex local service operation.
limitations: Integration verifies installed software bytes and UART/PCA command acknowledgements only; no formal physical boot/runtime, wiring or mechanical acceptance is asserted.
Wiring and mechanics revisions were not physically inspected; S45 remains inconclusive and target gates unchanged.
No arm, pulse or other movement command sent; no current, waveform, servo motion or physical power-disconnect measurement.
Without OE, failed I2C, ESP reset or a frozen loop can leave old PWM active.
observation: Private full16MiB pre-flash backup completed at460800baud with SHA256 recorded outside Git; the921600baud attempt had corrupt serial data and was retained as incomplete. Existing verified no-OE firmware SHA256 matches subject. Initial PlatformIO nobuild/upload wrote only application; bootloader at0x0 and partition table at0x8000 were explicitly completed with esptool using generated DIO/80m/16MB settings. verify_flash then returned digest matched for all three: bootloader22560 bytes, partition table3072 bytes, application201920 bytes at0x10000. UART after reset emitted SERVO_BENCH READY PWM FULL_OFF; GPIO1=SDA GPIO14=SCL no OE control PCA=0x40 nominal50Hz. Sent only stop newline; received SERVO_BENCH STOP PWM FULL_OFF. No motion commands. Private raw backup/logs remain outside repository.
